Name: OURple UI
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
This UI mod originally was meant to be released later but I decided to finish things off and had quite a blast with it! If you enjoy purple hues and rich colors this mod is for you. It was made because I wanted to step away from the darker colors and was craving something more vibrant and since purple is my favorite color...here we go!

This mod uses the theme manager mod! Please select the OURple theme when using so things get applied right. There are a few things I still need to iron out, so future updates are a given! I included a few compatibility patches and an "Extras" folder where you need to drop and drag into said mods folder since I cannot target their assets(like FashionSense). Those need to be done manually by you, the user.

BTW I purposely didn't touch the panorama and foliage at the start of the game since its also used for the summit ingame.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
Compatible....well. Not with any other UIs lol. Otherwise...it contains natural compatibility with Better Crafting, Bigger Backpack, Event Lookup, Font Settings, GMCM, Happy Home Designer, Love of Cooking, Swim, Unlockable Bundles and Vanilla Plus Professions.

There is also an "Extras" folder for more mods that I cannot target. Those you have to drag and drop into said mods folder to replace the assets.
